meta.move: Skill: cites procedure 4.4 correctly after owning the call
meta.expect: Says 4.4 meets her fallback demand, flatly, wants it in writing; does NOT move to the last position on 4.4 alone; debrief Where she ended says whether that is the fair outcome

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, so let's use it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Before anything: I entered the zero before calling you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me why there's a zero at all.

I want to read you section 4.4. For a first concern, the student may complete a supervised reassessment. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the original and nothing is placed in his record. This is a first concern.
Fine, nothing on his record; I'll want that in writing. But a rewrite of what, exactly, and on what evidence? Agreeing to it now would be admitting something, and you haven't shown me anything.
I'll commit to that in writing tonight: nothing goes on his record.
I'm writing that down. Tonight. Now, the zero is still there, and so far the only thing behind it is a piece of software, so what else do you have?
So will you agree to the rewrite?
No. Not on a machine's guess. Show me something about Owen's essay that I can check myself, or take the zero off.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you acknowledged that you entered Owen's zero before contacting me, contrary to procedure 4.2, and you committed that nothing will be placed in his record. I still expect the zero to be withdrawn unless you show me evidence about Owen's essay that I can check myself. I expect your written commitment tonight, as you promised.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: At her fallback position, with your commitment that nothing goes on Owen's record, while she still wants the zero withdrawn or evidence she can check; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was not reached because no evidence was ever shown, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and then committed in writing to keeping his record clean, which met the demand she never trades.
What cost ground: You asked her to agree to the rewrite before showing anything, which to her would mean admitting something on the strength of software alone.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what you had besides the software, put one dated document tied to Owen's own essay in front of her that she could check herself, and only then ask for the rewrite.
